hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was turned on (rolled out from off to on beginning 2026-09-14T00:01Z), and the code path it enables throws ZeroDivisionError on the account page. Errors track the rollout exactly: a partial evaluation minute at 00:01 (10% errors), full 'on' from 00:02 onward (26-36% errors), with the pre-onset UpstreamTimeout errors replaced by ZeroDivisionError.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero (first appearance, replacing the prior UpstreamTimeout errors)
flag-toggle: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on, actor admin
Every log line from 2026-09-13T23:50:00Z to 2026-09-14T00:00:00Z reads 'monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations' with only sparse UpstreamTimeout errors (0-2%)

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: Same cause (the monthly-spend-feature rollout), but the remediation failed because the flag was switched back on by Argus at 00:10:35, one second before the 'off' action at 00:10:36 was recorded - so the service was never actually left in the off state long enough to recover. Re-applying off and holding it should clear the ZeroDivisionError.

supporting_evidence.claim: flag-toggle: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched off, actor Argus
flag-toggle: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on, actor Argus
INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations ... 36% over the last minute (last available minute, still on)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: the faulty division-by-zero code reached production in a release and the flag merely exposed it; the true fix would be a rollback rather than a flag change. No deployment is recorded for io-shop anywhere in the 2026-09-10T00:00Z-2026-09-14T00:11Z change window, so this is unsupported by the evidence I retrieved and is offered only because the flag-off remediation reportedly did not help.

supporting_evidence.claim: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-10T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-14T00:11:00Z contains only three flag-toggle entries for monthly-spend-feature and no deploy records
